summary: WavyGo OS Part 2 full-stack test — 100% pass on backend (31/31 pytest) and frontend (all 5 new module pages + enhanced dashboard). Backend: verified enhanced /api/dashboard/stats returns exactly 9 KPIs with the expected keys (revenue, revenue_today, revenue_week, bookings, bookings_today, active_bookings, customers, vehicles, vendors) plus vendor_perf, company_health {score,signals,flags}, system_status with 5 services, and recent_notifications. Marketplace: /dashboard, /analytics, list endpoints (cities/vendors/vehicles/customers/pricing/coupons/reviews/bookings/kyc/support) all 200; >=5 seeded vendors, >=30 seeded bookings. Created vendor via POST → persisted and appears in GET list; KYC PATCH approved cascaded vendor.kyc_status='approved'; booking status transitions pending→confirmed→active→completed all worked. Tasks: /stats/overview returns all 6 columns; created task via POST appears under status filter; PATCH /status transitions; POST /comments persists and enriches; assignee (employee) received 'assigned' notification via GET /api/notifications. Employees: /stats, /, /departments/list, /attendance/records, /leave/requests, /performance/reviews all 200; Intern invite → 403 as required; Founder invite → 201 with temp_password='Wavygo@2026' and new user can log in. Leave workflow: employee POSTs leave, founder PATCH approves → employee gets 'Your leave was approved' notification. Opportunities: /stats, POST create, POST /assign work; assignee notified. Connect: 5 seeded channels visible (announcements/general/operations/product/founders); GET/POST messages on general work; POST /dm/{peer_id} idempotently returns/creates a DM channel of kind=dm. Activity trail correctly logs Task Board entries after task creation. Part 1 regression (login, live-kpis, settings/company, /activity, /notifications) still 100%. Frontend UI (Playwright as Founder): login → /dashboard; dashboard renders founder-dashboard + vendor-performance + company-health + system-status + recent-notifications testids. Marketplace page loads with all 12 mp-tab-* triggers (dashboard/bookings/customers/vendors/vehicles/cities/pricing/coupons/kyc/support/reviews/analytics). Task Board renders taskboard-page + all 5 kanban-column-* (todo, in_progress, review, completed, cancelled); creating a task through task-create-btn/task-title-input/task-submit-btn appended it to UI. Employees, Opportunity Hub, Connect pages all mount their root testids. Connect: sending 'UI ping from pytest' via connect-message-input/connect-send-btn appended into #general chat (visible in final screenshot). Sidebar renders all 17 items inside AppShell across every page.

issues: Recharts still logs 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warnings on initial paint — same cosmetic issue flagged in iteration_1; add explicit minHeight/aspect on ResponsiveContainer.

action_items: Cosmetic only: set explicit min-height on Recharts ResponsiveContainer on Dashboard to silence width(-1)/height(-1) warnings.
(Carried from iteration_1) Welcome toast still overlays top-nav briefly after login; reposition or make pointer-events:none.
critical_code_review_comments: marketplace_router._crud PATCH endpoint accepts a raw dict — no schema validation on update payload; a malformed body could set unexpected fields (e.g., 'active':'yes'). Consider a partial Pydantic update model.

tasks_router.delete_task and opportunities_router.delete_opp are gated only by get_current_user — any authenticated user (including Intern) can delete any task/opportunity. Add require_roles for destructive ops.

connect_router.list_channels visibility: OR of (kind∈channel/announcement) OR (members contains me) means any authenticated user can see ALL public channels including 'founders' (kind=group but currently seeded as channel?). Verify seeded 'founders' has proper kind so it's restricted.
dashboard_router.stats aggregates like $regex on created_at is not indexable; on real volume this will be slow. Consider storing created_at as BSON Date.
employees_router.invite: default password 'Wavygo@2026' is returned in response — fine for MVP, but for prod, generate a random temp password and force reset on first login.
CORS_ORIGINS still '*' with allow_credentials — same finding from iteration_1, remains unaddressed.
